summary.text: Gouache … body color, or opaque watercolor is a water-medium paint consisting of natural pigment, water, a binding agent (usually gum arabic or dextrin), and sometimes additional inert material.
Washes of opaque color were gradually added to the underdrawing; as they built up layer upon layer, these were fused to the paper fibers by repeated [burnishing].
